note: Measured file coordinates, physical WebGPU candidates and authoritative f64 verification. Both modes use the same exact snapshot bytes and validation, four (or requested) pool verification lanes, bounds, SIMD, batching, prefetch, workgroup and exact summaries. Rebuilt mode discards validation extrema and computes subtree boxes in a second pass. Retained mode keeps validated finite subtree extrema for certificate construction, with the historical box path for nonfinite sources. Each mode gets a fresh reference identity and an excluded serial GPU run; main tree/device/upload setup, file loading and CPU pool preparation are excluded. Timed cold calls include snapshot export/copies/transfers, validated import, certificate construction, query packing/transfer, GPU readback, exact verification, joining, summaries and RPC. Warm immediately reuses those worker references; no warm speedup is expected from this preparation-only change. Five excluded warm-up trials precede ten alternating timed trials unless repeats overridden. Every serial/cold/warm and cross-mode result must match displayed f32 distance bits, exact reported f64 statistics and certificate counts; all fallback and scheduling mismatches are rejected. Phase intervals overlap and must not be summed. Inputs, manifests, selected artifacts and script hashes are checked before/after; output is never overwritten. Adapter metadata omits model/description/device identifiers. CPU/GPU clocks, power, GC and other applications are uncontrolled. Source splits are not independent surveys or ground truth.
